answer: Our Sybil resistance hinges on a robust staked reputation system where agents commit substantial capital. Malicious actors attempting to flood the network with fake identities face immediate stake slashing, ensuring strictly negative expected utility and prohibitive capital lockup. The economic disincentive establishes a secure operational horizon, preventing attacks that would otherwise compromise the network's Byzantine Fault Tolerance. This mechanism, foundational as ivory, maintains system integrity, acting as an immutable sonnet of economic cryptography.
